name: fortinet-mr-automation-review
description: Find GitLab MRs labelled (e.g.) forge:stage::needs_review AND forge:keyword::automation_test → for each: build via Jenkins, upgrade a NAC in a TP lab to the new build, run the pytest case linked from the bug's Mantis description, post results back to the MR and flip the stage label to tested_passed / tested_failed. v0.2: 15-node fine-grained DAG (each node = one HTTP call / one shell action, retryable in isolation) with a route-platform extension hook (currently TP-only; future platforms gate via __SKIP__).
author: forge
